text: Tea is my morning ritual. I drink green tea from a big cup. A cup of tea makes the day calm.
Coffee prices rose again this year. Traders expect coffee demand to grow. The market for coffee is volatile.
I prefer green tea over coffee. A cup of green tea with honey is lovely. My sister drinks black tea.
Coffee exports fell sharply. The coffee harvest was poor, and prices for coffee climbed.
Some days I drink a cup of coffee, but tea wins. Hot tea, a cup of tea, and a quiet book.
Tea imports grew, while coffee imports fell. Analysts say green tea is gaining market share.
TEA and COFFEE futures were quiet. Tea traders waited for the harvest.
Green tea, green tea, always green tea. A cup of tea is a small ritual.
